Your teams get chat. You keep control.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eUnder the hood it's one control plane for your AI agents — one MCP endpoint for all your agents, tools, and models. Agents package context, tools, and policy into something you publish to the organization. Connections give them governed access to your systems — GitHub, Slack, Postgres, Sentry, anything that speaks MCP — with tokens stored in an encrypted vault. Models stay interchangeable: OpenRouter or direct providers, chosen per agent and per tool.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eStart with one team. Standardize approved models, tools, and context. Expand across the organization without copying secrets or rebuilding the platform. Install locally and it stays private; sync to the cloud for remote access, team roles, and shared billing.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"snippet-clipboard-content notranslate position-relative Register MCP servers at the organization level through a web UI with one-click OAuth — no JSON configs. Tokens live in the encrypted vault, and you grant tool-level access by organization, role, or agent. Share MCP capabilities — not credentials.\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eAs tool surfaces grow, Studio exposes \u003cstrong\u003eVirtual MCPs\u003c/strong\u003e — one endpoint, different strategies for which tools to surface:\u003c/p\u003e\n\u003cul dir=\"auto\"\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eFull-context:\u003c/strong\u003e expose everything (simple, deterministic, good for small toolsets)\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eSmart selection:\u003c/strong\u003e narrow the toolset before execution\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003cli\u003e\u003cstrong\u003eCode execution:\u003c/strong\u003e load tools on demand in a sandbox\u003c/li\u003e\n\u003c/ul\u003e\n\u003cdiv class=\"markdown-heading\" dir=\"auto\"\u003e\u003ch3 tabindex=\"-1\" class=\"heading-element\" dir=\"auto\"\u003eModels\u003c/h3\u003e\u003ca id=\"user-content-models\" class=\"anchor\" aria-label=\"Permalink: Models\" href=\"#models\"\u003e\u003csvg data-component=\"Octicon\" class=\"octicon octicon-link\" viewBox=\"0 0 16 16\" version=\"1.1\" width=\"16\" height=\"16\" aria-hidden=\"true\"\u003e\u003cpath d=\"m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z\"\u003e\u003c/path\u003e\u003c/svg\u003e\u003c/a\u003e\u003c/div\u003e\n\u003cp dir=\"auto\"\u003eKeep the AI layer interchangeable. <div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h2 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">What is deco Studio?</h2><a id="user-content-what-is-deco-studio" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: What is deco Studio?" href="#what-is-deco-studio"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Studio packages the infrastructure behind an internal AI rollout: model routing, MCP authentication, agent configuration, SSO, RBAC, audit logs, and usage accounting. Your teams get chat. You keep control.</p>
<p dir="auto">Under the hood it's one control plane for your AI agents — one MCP endpoint for all your agents, tools, and models. Agents package context, tools, and policy into something you publish to the organization. Connections give them governed access to your systems — GitHub, Slack, Postgres, Sentry, anything that speaks MCP — with tokens stored in an encrypted vault. Models stay interchangeable: OpenRouter or direct providers, chosen per agent and per tool.</p>
<p dir="auto">Start with one team. Standardize approved models, tools, and context. Expand across the organization without copying secrets or rebuilding the platform. Install locally and it stays private; sync to the cloud for remote access, team roles, and shared billing.</p>

<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Agents</h3><a id="user-content-agents" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Agents" href="#agents"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Package context, tools, and policy into an agent. Define instructions, add skills and files, grant approved MCP access, choose a model policy, then publish the agent to the organization. Each agent is its own MCP endpoint — callable from Cursor, Claude Desktop, your own code, or another agent. Agents compose, and every action is tracked with cost attribution.</p>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Connections</h3><a id="user-content-connections" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Connections" href="#connections"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Connect private systems once, securely. Register MCP servers at the organization level through a web UI with one-click OAuth — no JSON configs. Tokens live in the encrypted vault, and you grant tool-level access by organization, role, or agent. Share MCP capabilities — not credentials.</p>
<p dir="auto">As tool surfaces grow, Studio exposes <strong>Virtual MCPs</strong> — one endpoint, different strategies for which tools to surface:</p>
<ul dir="auto">
<li><strong>Full-context:</strong> expose everything (simple, deterministic, good for small toolsets)</li>
<li><strong>Smart selection:</strong> narrow the toolset before execution</li>
<li><strong>Code execution:</strong> load tools on demand in a sandbox</li>
</ul>
<div class="markdown-heading" dir="auto"><h3 tabindex="-1" class="heading-element" dir="auto">Models</h3><a id="user-content-models" class="anchor" aria-label="Permalink: Models" href="#models"><svg data-component="Octicon" class="octicon octicon-link" viewBox="0 0 16 16" version="1.1" width="16" height="16" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m7.775 3.275 1.25-1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1 4.95 4.95l-2.5 2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1-4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1 .018-1.042.751.751 0 0 1 1.042-.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l2.5-2.5a2.002 2.002 0 0 0-2.83-2.83l-1.25 1.25a.751.751 0 0 1-1.042-.018.751.751 0 0 1-.018-1.042Zm-4.69 9.64a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 2.83 0l1.25-1.25a.751.751 0 0 1 1.042.018.751.751 0 0 1 .018 1.042l-1.25 1.25a3.5 3.5 0 1 1-4.95-4.95l2.5-2.5a3.5 3.5 0 0 1 4.95 0 .751.751 0 0 1-.018 1.042.751.751 0 0 1-1.042.018 1.998 1.998 0 0 0-2.83 0l-2.5 2.5a1.998 1.998 0 0 0 0 2.83Z"></path></svg></a></div>
<p dir="auto">Keep the AI layer interchangeable. Use OpenRouter or connect Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, or any compatible provider directly — the best model for each agent and tool, behind one router. For coding work, engineers can link their own Claude Code or Codex session and use the subscription already authenticated on their machine.</p>
